items.title: SBI to hire 12,000 employees, add 250 branches in FY27, says State Bank of India's chairman CS Setty
items.summary: State Bank of India (SBI) intends to hire about 12,000 employees and add around 250 new branches to its network in the ongoing financial year, said C S Setty, Chairman of the country's biggest lender.

items.title: From sponsorships to storytelling: how ITC Foods is going local with festivals
items.summary: The festive season is an important advertising period for all consumer companies. But as regional festivals become more popular, not just in their home states but across the country, brands are trying to find ways to be present as authentically as possible.

items.title: Not just Adobe's new CEO Anil Chakravarthy, meet Indian-origin C-Suite leaders heading top global companies — Profiles
items.summary: From Big Tech stalwarts like Microsoft and Alphabet to legacy conglomerates across logistics and consumer goods, check out the Indian-origin C-suite leaders heading the world’s biggest companies

items.title: CIL offers additional coal to power plants as stocks decline: Here's what led to critically low levels
items.summary: Coal India has offered additional coal to power plants amid critically low stocks, with prolonged rains disrupting mining and transportation. As rainfall eases, production and coal evacuation are expected to improve.

items.title: NCLT stays disposal of Byju's K3-linked assets: ‘Articles worth ₹150 crore auctioned for about ₹16 crore’
items.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) put a hold on any further disposal of Byju's K3 Education's assets till the next hearing on September 21.

items.title: US Grip on Venezuelan Oil Threatens Billions Owed to China
items.summary: Venezuela is becoming a major testing ground for Donald Trump’s hemispheric ambitions, and emerging as another potential source of rivalry with China.

items.title: Jio completes 10 years: Akash Ambani in heartfelt letter to employees says, ‘Whatever pride I feel today belongs to you’
items.summary: Jio completes 10 years: Akash Ambani thanks employees, reflects on his personal journey and outlines the company’s plans for its next decade.

items.title: Adani Defence signs 5-year ammunition deal for India-made AK-203 assault rifles: All you need to know
items.summary: Adani Defence & Aerospace has signed a five-year contract with Indo-Russian Rifles Pvt Ltd to supply 7.62x39 mm ammunition for AK-203 rifles, enhancing India's domestic defense manufacturing and supporting the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative.

items.title: Who’ll be next Tata Sons Chairman? TV Narendran or Saurabh Agarwal? But, NSE’s Ashish Chauhan emerges as dark horse
items.summary: While Narendran has emerged as the frontrunner among internal candidates, Agrawal is also in the reckoning with his investment-banking and capital-allocation experience. Chauhan, a veteran of India's capital markets and one of the founding executives of the NSE, could turn out to be the dark horse.

items.title: TCS’s HyperVault to build 1GW AI data centre in Telangana's Hyderabad: Inside ₹70,000 crore ‘historic’ project
items.summary: TCS's HyperVault AI Data Center will create an AI-focused facility in Hyderabad with a 1 GW capacity, supported by ₹70,000 crore investment. The project promises job creation and aims to become a leading AI infrastructure hub, integrating advanced technologies and sustainability practices.

items.title: Jaguar Land Rover layoffs: Tata-owned carmaker announces 4,000 job cuts, says ‘we must adapt’ - What we know
items.summary: The British carmaker has told employees and trade union partners that it is opening a voluntary redundancy programme for salaried and management staff.

items.title: Subhash Chandra’s troubles mount: CBI files FIR alleging net worth ‘inflation’ to secure ₹980 cr loan from LICHFL
items.summary: CBI has filed an FIR against Subhash Chandra, alleging his net worth was inflated to secure ₹980 crore in LICHFL loans that later went into default.

items.title: An old India Inc habit: Ignore the nudge, wait for the stick
PUBG-fame Krafton to invest another $250 million in India as it expands beyond gaming
items.summary: Krafton, the creator of BGMI, plans to invest an additional $250 million in India over the next few years, doubling its total investment. The South Korean gaming company has backed numerous startups and continues to strengthen its local operations.

items.title: Bajaj Group's Bajel Projects skips the elephant dance, opts for a steady walk
items.summary: Bajaj Group’s EPC firm Bajel Projects is resisting the temptation to chase rapid growth even as India’s renewable energy push lifts demand for power transmission. Instead, it is picking projects carefully, sharpening execution, expanding capacity and looking overseas for better margins.

items.title: “Unbecoming of trustee”: Tata Trusts comment, says Vijay Singh; Tata Trusts say the charity commissioner said so.
items.summary: The charity commissioner's dismissal of a Tata Sons share transfer probe included sharp criticism of trustee Vijay Singh's conduct—a remark Singh attributes to the Trusts' own filing, while the organization insists it originated from the regulator.
